Title: Health Check
Notes: Liveness check for webapps-syncprocess-backend. The handler validates BASIC_AUTH_USER and BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD even though this route is outside the Chi Basic middleware group. Success body is the plain text ok.

Title: Run Item SO Sync
Error Messages: invalid JSON body; request body too large; no matching outlets for the given CompanyID, BrandID, and/or OutletID
Notes: Mirrors Sync_Item_SO. An empty body is valid and syncs all brand targets. Optional CompanyID, BrandID, and OutletID filters intersect Ms_Outlet. Request body max 16 KiB. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Item Sync
Notes: Mirrors Sync_Item. No request body. Syncs item master data from ESB MySQL into SQL Server in one transaction. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Item HPP Sync
Notes: Mirrors Sync_ItemHPP. No request body. Syncs item HPP (cost) data from ESB into SQL Server. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Asset Sync
Notes: Mirrors the asset sync job. No request body. Syncs item categories and assets from ESB into SQL Server. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run BOM Sync
Notes: Mirrors Sync_BOM. No request body. Syncs bill of materials data. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run ESB BOM Sync
Error Messages: company_id is required; invalid JSON body; request body too large
Notes: Mirrors Sync_ESB_BOM for one company. company_id is required. The handler rejects an empty body. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request body max 16 KiB. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Applicant Sync
Notes: Mirrors Sync_Applicant. No request body. Refreshes Ms_Applicant from the Orange linked server (delete, insert, status update) without an explicit distributed transaction. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Employee Sync
Notes: Mirrors the employee sync job. No request body. Upserts organization, department, position, employee, contact, and work-location master data in one transaction. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Sales Sync
Notes: Mirrors Sync_Sales. No request body. Deletes recent Trx_SalesSummary rows and inserts from BogaDW in one transaction. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Stock Opname Difference Sync
Error Messages: invalid JSON body; request body too large; data for this period has already been generated
Notes: Mirrors the stock-opname difference job. An empty body is valid and processes every company for the current period. Optional BrandID limits the run. When BrandID is omitted and the period was already generated, the API returns 400. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run Supplier Sync
Notes: Mirrors the supplier sync job. No request body. Syncs supplier master data from ESB into SQL Server. Success JSON is {"status":"ok"}. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Run MSDB Mail Maintenance
Error Messages: invalid JSON body; request body too large
Notes: MSDB Database Mail history cleanup. An empty body is valid: retentionDays defaults to 30 and mail is not stopped. When stopMailDuringRun is true, Database Mail is stopped before delete and always restarted after. Success JSON includes status, retentionDays, cutoffDate, mail item counts, and mailStopped or mailRestarted flags. Request timeout is SYNC_RUN_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 3600 seconds).

Title: Purge Request Logs
Notes: Deletes PostgreSQL request_log rows older than two calendar months (UTC). Requires HTTP Basic and header X-Audit-Admin-Key equal to AUDIT_ADMIN_KEY. No request body. Success JSON is {"deleted":<count>}.

Title: Purge Request Logs 2
Notes: Deletes PostgreSQL request_log rows older than two calendar months (UTC). Requires HTTP Basic and header X-Audit-Admin-Key equal to AUDIT_ADMIN_KEY. No request body. Success JSON is {"deleted":<count>}.
